lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Write a complex theme claim for your play and name one motif to track.

FEEDBACK
Strong answer: Full idea with tension; motif concrete.

CHECK
Reducing the play to 'love conquers all' without counter-evidence.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Track a motif in three places and draft two competing theme claims with evidence bullets.

Write a short reflection describing one specific revision you made and why.
